<!-- Pick ONE kind of pull request. A result submission may not contain other changes. -->

## Kind

- [ ] Result submission (`submissions/<my-github-handle>/<model-slug>.json`, new files only)
- [ ] Code or documentation change (no protected paths, see CONTRIBUTING.md)

## For a result submission

- [ ] Produced with an unmodified `scripts/benchmarks/well_known_suite.py` at the commit in `runtime.suite_commit`
- [ ] File generated by `scripts/reporting/submission.py make`; no score typed by hand
- [ ] Raw evidence archive is public, and its SHA-256 and size are in the file
- [ ] Model weights were obtained and used within their license

## For a code change

- [ ] `python -m pytest -q` output pasted below (actual counts)
- [ ] No change to prompts, samples, stop strings, scorers or aggregation (those need a new protocol ID and a maintainer)
